name: EasyEA Official Package Registry
description: Catalogo ufficiale dei pacchetti e framework architetturali per EasyEA

packages.name: BIAN Banking Architecture Standard (v12.0)
packages.author: Banking Industry Architecture Network (BIAN)
packages.description: Banking Industry Architecture Network (BIAN Service Landscape v12.0) - Comprehensive canonical reference architecture featuring 8 Business Areas, Business Domains, 240+ Service Domains, Control Records, Canonical Relationships, and Architecture Views.
packages.release_notes: Full BIAN Service Landscape v12.0: 8 Business Areas, 240+ Service Domains, Control Records, Canonical Relationships and Views.

packages.name: IT4IT™ Reference Architecture
packages.author: The Open Group
packages.description: The Open Group IT4IT Standard v3.0 - Open industry standard for the IT Operating Model and digital product value streams (Digital Product Backbone, DevOps, CI/CD, Service Management).

packages.name: TM Forum ODA & eTOM Telecom Standard
packages.description: TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) & Business Process Framework (eTOM GB921 v23.5) - Standard canonical reference architecture for Telecommunications, 5G networks, cloud-native OSS/BSS, and Digital Service Providers.
packages.author: TM Forum Open Architecture Program
packages.release_notes: First release of TM Forum ODA & eTOM v23.5 reference package: eTOM Operations/SIP/Enterprise processes, ODA components, TMF Open APIs and SID entities.

packages.name: RAMI 4.0 & ISA-95 Smart Manufacturing Standard
packages.description: Reference Architectural Model Industrie 4.0 (RAMI 4.0 - DIN SPEC 91345) & ISA-95 (IEC 62264) - Standard canonical reference architecture for Smart Factory, OT/IT convergence, Asset Administration Shell (AAS Digital Twin), and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM/MES).
packages.author: Plattform Industrie 4.0 & MESA International
packages.release_notes: First release of RAMI 4.0 & ISA-95 reference framework: 3D coordinates, MOM operations, OT/IT integration, Asset Administration Shell (AAS) Digital Twin, and Smart Factory views.

packages.name: ACORD Insurance Standard Framework
packages.description: ACORD Capability Model, Component Model & Information Framework - Standard canonical reference architecture for Property & Casualty (P&C), Life & Annuities, Underwriting, Claims FNOL-to-Settlement, and Solvency II / IFRS 17 compliance.
packages.author: ACORD Association
packages.release_notes: First release of ACORD Insurance Framework: Underwriting, Policy Administration, Claims FNOL-to-Settlement, Billing, Reinsurance, and Solvency II / IFRS 17 views.

packages.name: SGAM & IEC CIM Smart Grid Standard
packages.description: Smart Grid Architecture Model (SGAM / CEN-CENELEC-ETSI) & Common Information Model (IEC CIM) - Canonical reference architecture for Power Utilities, Transmission (TSO), Distribution (DSO), Substation Automation (IEC 61850), Smart Metering (AMI), and DER Flexibility.
packages.author: CEN-CENELEC-ETSI & IEC TC57
packages.release_notes: First release of SGAM & IEC CIM Smart Grid framework: 3D coordinates (Domains & Zones), Substation Automation (IEC 61850), ADMS/EMS systems, FLISR self-healing, and CIM data model.

packages.name: SCOR Digital Standard (ASCM)
packages.description: Supply Chain Operations Reference Digital Standard (SCOR DS - ASCM) - Canonical reference architecture for End-to-End Supply Chain, Orchestrate, Plan, Order, Source, Transform, Deliver, and Return operations.
packages.author: Association for Supply Chain Management (ASCM)
packages.release_notes: First release of SCOR Digital Standard (SCOR DS): 7 fundamental pillars (Plan, Order, Source, Transform, Deliver, Return, Orchestrate), WMS/TMS/SCP systems, OTIF metrics, and Order-to-Delivery pipeline.
